scripts.db:migrate: docker compose exec nest_server pnpm --filter=backend run migrate up
scripts.db:migrate:down: docker compose exec nest_server pnpm --filter=backend run migrate down 1
scripts.db:migrate:status: docker compose exec -T postgres_db sh -c 'psql -U "$POSTGRES_USER" -d "$POSTGRES_DB" -c "table pgmigrations order by id"'
scripts.db:seed: docker compose exec -T postgres_db sh -c 'psql -U "$POSTGRES_USER" -d "$POSTGRES_DB" -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1' < apps/backend/db/seed.sql
scripts.db:test: docker compose exec nest_server pnpm --filter=backend run test:e2e
scripts.docker:rebuild: docker compose up -d --build --force-recreate --renew-anon-volumes && docker compose logs -f
scripts.docker:reset: docker compose down -v --remove-orphans && docker compose build --no-cache && docker compose up -d && docker compose logs -f
